ways.label: Aickens over Harper Pass to Windy Point on the Lewis Pass Highway

end.name: Windy Point shelter and car park
end.quote: the shelter and car park at Windy Point

evidence: This trip starts at Aickens car park beside SH73, 5 km west of Otira township.
If Otira River is safe to cross, start from the Aickens car park, cross the stile and follow the fence line to the river.
The trip finishes at the shelter and car park at Windy Point, just off Lewis Pass Highway on SH7.

side_trips.name: Kiwi Hut
side_trips.from: Taramakau true right about a kilometre above the Otehake

not_on_route.name: Amuri Area School Outdoor Education Centre
not_on_route.quote: Amuri Area School Outdoor Education Centre

doubts: Start: two road end features (F1, F2) where unnamed tracks meet the Otira Highway lie about 1 km from the Aickens place and 250 m apart; the text does not let me tell which is the track from Aickens car park, so the Aickens place (T7) is given instead. End: F3, where an unnamed track meets Lewis Pass Road about 800 m from Windy Point (T24), is taken as the Windy Point shelter and car park; the text says the car park is 5 minutes down the shingle road at Windy Point, so this is likely but not certain. Kiwi Hut is reached by a short side-track and ends the first section, so it is listed both on the way and as a hut. The 'Lake Kaurapataka side trip or round trip' section (6–7 hours or 1–2 days return, with a 1–2 hour loop via the Otehake) has its own heading and time but is a trip to a different destination off the route, so it is recorded as a side trip from Pfeifer Creek rather than a way of doing the Harper Pass Route. The eastern side is also described on the Harper Pass Track page (L1). The emergency flood track to the Morrison footbridge is not a way.
